revision: TASK-0762: 8 floors (floor 7 = Atlas, visibility; the Owner is floor 8) and 33 camera beats (4,4,4,6,3,5,5,2). One continuous path: the whole tower, then per floor enter -> beats in the room -> pull out and rise.
notes: progress = the page scroll of the pinned <scene-3d> section, 0..1 (the player's progress; the keys in scene-3d.json are placed through the player's smoothstep ease, these values are page-scroll). range = the scroll that belongs to the floor (from the middle of the flight before to the middle of the flight after). hold = the camera is inside the room and slowly pushes in on the agent: show the caption fully there, fade it in during [range[0], hold[0]]. node = the agent's GLB node (an empty at chest height); stop_node = an empty over the agent's head; lamp_node = the room's amber lamp (glow). caption_anchor = [x, y] on screen, 0..1 from the top left, where the caption box starts. anchor_world = the point over the agent's head in the scene's Z-up coordinates (the same frame as the scroll keys), for a site that projects its own anchor. beats = the page-scroll progress where each view of the room is reached (the first = the entry hold); hold = the first..last beat of the floor. Step between beats of one room 0.02334, between floors 0.03735. Owner of the length: the site may replace it.

phone.kind: frame sequence of the portrait camera path (phones) + the same path live (portrait tablets)
phone.progress_of_frame: i / 47 (page-scroll progress of the pinned section)
phone.note: The portrait path (scene-3d.phone.json) has the same model and the same 'at' values, so ranges, holds and beats apply as they are; every beat frames its own subject in the middle. The 48 frames are captured from it at 720x1280.
phone.script: tour-phone.js: load it as a module BEFORE scene-3d/scene-3d.js. Phones (<=767 px): the element is replaced before the 3D loads by a sticky canvas of the same scroll length scrubbing the frames (no GLB download); children with data-at rise at the same progress. Portrait tablets (768-1024 px): the element is pointed at scene-3d.phone.json. Reduced motion / Save-Data: the poster still.
